invariants.rationale: If node.parent was non-null it would have returned earlier; at this point node.parent must be null.
If rootNodes.removeValue(node, true) returned true, then node is no longer in rootNodes.
If actorIndex != -1, removeFromTree would have been called, which should remove node's actor from this.
The method is called with a non-null argument, or a null node would cause a NullPointerException earlier.
Method assumes rootNodes is non-null (as shown by calling removeValue on it without null checks).
